scripts.build:www: rm -rf www && mkdir -p www/vendor/capacitor-firebase-authentication && cp index.html www/index.html && cp -r biblioteca www/biblioteca && cp node_modules/@capacitor/core/dist/index.js www/vendor/capacitor-core.esm.js && cp node_modules/@capacitor-firebase/authentication/dist/esm/*.js www/vendor/capacitor-firebase-authentication/ && node scripts/fix-vendor-imports.js
scripts.cap:sync: npm run build:www && npx cap sync
scripts.cap:open:ios: npm run cap:sync && npx cap open ios
scripts.cap:open:android: npm run cap:sync && npx cap open android
